Name: CHARMAKEMENU_LISTITEM_PARAM_ST
Description: Choices of Elden Ring's character creator lists (body type, age, voice, origin and so on). NR has no character creator, but its status screen code still looks up the captions of rows 100000, 100100, 100200 and 100300 from the player's creator values; whether they are shown in NR is not established. Retail: Elden Ring's base-game rows, unchanged.

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: Value written to the entry's creator value when this choice is picked (e.g. a part model number, an origin index); the current value also selects which choice's caption is shown.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown on the choice's icon grid tile.
